3. The trial Court decreed the suit on the finding that the suit was maintainable in the civil Court by Judgment and decree dated 24-2-90. On appeal the learned Subordinate Judge Kurigram in Title Appeal No.32 of 1990 affirmed the Judgment and decree of the trial Court by those dated 18-9-90. The defendants preferred Civil Revision No. 26 of 1991 and a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division by the Judgment and order dated 23-1-97 discharged the Rule from which the defendant petitioner has preferred this petition for leave to appeal. 

 4. Kazi Golam Mahboob, learned Advocate for the petitioner, submits that the plaintiff’s suit was decreed by the lower appellate Court on the ground that his service was terminated not by a competent authority. The petitioner filed an application before the revisional Court for adducing additional evidence to show that the plaintiffs service was terminated by the competent authority but the High Court Division, exercising revisional jurisdiction, wrongly held that a revisional Court cannot consider any new evidence at this stage.
